svg.title: A 9-year tree, 114540 commits, in blossom: 205-day streak, 7 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of whale, drawn for 2025-10-08. Season: autumn. Maturity level 13 of 13, in a antique pot. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
